HOLD already expresses the view: TP 87.985 is +1.5R (~3 ATR) past 4h lows 88.67/88.24, stop 1.0R above. The one real tail effect is small and the atr:1.0/r:0 stops (0.18R/0.0R away from price) are inside the last hour's 1.8 ATR range, under the 1 ATR minimum buffer and noise-stop prone on a chop 1h, so no tighten beats hold, and tightening class evidence (981 stop-tightens -0.097R) leans the same way. No ATR expansion for a widen/move_tp. Book: SOL ml_entry short duplicates the SOL sol_pullback_2h (+0.229R) and trend_donchian_sol_4h (+2.44R) shorts and the ETH/ADA ml_entry shorts, one crypto-beta short bet across about a dozen packages, flagged not sized. XRP from the same signal was refused by Bybit (110007 insufficient margin), so it has no position and is not part of this book. -0.13 R/decision 14d is a whole-table replay and Unit 23 puts shorts about flat; not weighed. Revisit if a 1h bar closes above 90.02 or the 4h swing low 88.67 breaks (then trail toward structure).
